expected: BS-P1-020 must make DO_NOT_PERSIST input lifecycle implementable across POST /intents and POST /intents/{id}/compile without persisting protected values or requiring implementation to invent transport/re-provision semantics.
actual: Independent BCE audit of PR #290 confirmed the locked design requires request-scoped EphemeralResolvedContext for Prompt B and User re-provision on retry, but the compile request contract does not define the field, shape, binding, validation, or idempotency behavior for supplying those values. PR #290 therefore selected a narrower behavior that rejects referenced DO_NOT_PERSIST inputs before Prompt B. A separate FAILED_TERMINAL replay defect remains implementation remediation and does not widen this Design delta.
evidence: Issue #245 RESULT comment 6016578938 reported the DO_NOT_PERSIST behavior as a Finding candidate.
Issue #245 independent BCE audit comment 6016838295 classified the remaining DO_NOT_PERSIST lifecycle ambiguity as SPEC_GAP and blocked PR #290 merge.
BS-P1-020 F01-DATA-005 requires DO_NOT_PERSIST values to be non-durable, permits request-scoped EphemeralResolvedContext for Prompt B, and requires User re-provision when context is absent.
BS-P1-020 F01 compile API does not define a bounded request field/schema for those re-provided values.
appf2-design PR #30 merged the bounded BF-050 F01 addenda as af3fc11f7326e58955c17b850cb4427a4f27ddd1.
Scope-clean freeze source 2e8a3f45a281c981b6bd7e4f10ceca22b5f47c9f adds exactly the three BF-050 addenda to the BS-P1-020 source and no other Design path.

attempts.evidence: Candidate #290 passed structural gates but independent semantic audit blocked merge on DO_NOT_PERSIST lifecycle ambiguity.

requested_planning_action: Lock value-free durable EphemeralInputRequirement descriptors while keeping values non-durable.
Lock compile request-scoped ephemeral_inputs transport, binding and validation.
Lock missing/mismatched ephemeral input recovery so User re-provision is explicit.
Lock idempotency interaction: ephemeral values affect request_digest but raw values are never persisted; same-body retry resubmits them with the same key; material value change uses a new key.
Keep SUCCEEDED/FAILED_TERMINAL replay bound to same-key+same-digest durable outcome truth without re-running Prompt B or persisting the ephemeral values.
Freeze a replacement Build Spec, rebind SP-P1-003/T001, and stop before Cursor execution.
affected_contracts: Shared mutation idempotency interaction with request-scoped ephemeral values
